decisions.decision: InlineLabelEditor keeps the text it shows in local state (reset when the item changes) and reports each change up
decisions.why: React Flow passes node and edge data through its own store a render late, so a field controlled by the draft was rewritten after each key and lost its caret; one change in the shared editor covers every canvas
decisions.rejected: Restoring the selection after each prop change (fragile under fast typing and IME composition) or bypassing React Flow data for the editor (wider change)
